definitions.explanation: an approximate calculation or estimate that gives a general idea of a quantity or cost without precise details

examples.japanese: {概算|がいさん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{百万円|ひゃくまんえん}くらい⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: It will cost roughly one million yen.

examples.japanese: {概算|がいさん}{見積|みつも}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}して→出す：01087_dasu⟧⟦もらえます→もらう：00520_morau⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Could you give me a rough estimate?

examples.japanese: ⟦{費用|ひよう}→費用：03588_hiyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{概算|がいさん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{計算|けいさん}して→計算する：25526_keisansuru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{正式|せいしき}→正式：03376_seishiki⟧な⟦{見積|みつも}り→見積り：04699_mitsumori⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: We'll provide a formal estimate after calculating a rough approximation of the costs.

notes:
FORMS:
{概|がい} (approximate, general) + {算|さん} (calculation) → rough calculation

CAN FUNCTION AS:
- Noun: {概算|がいさん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧ (to provide an estimate)
- Suru-verb: {概算|がいさん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to make a rough estimate)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {概算|がいさん}{見積|みつも}り (rough estimate/quote)
- {概算|がいさん}⟦{費用|ひよう}→費用：03588_hiyou⟧ (estimated cost)
- {概算|がいさん}⟦{要求|ようきゅう}→要求：03658_youkyuu⟧ (budget request - government term)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{試算|しさん}→試算：08326_shisan⟧ (trial calculation)
- ⟦{見積|みつも}り→見積り：04699_mitsumori⟧ (estimate, quotation)
- ⟦{精算|せいさん}→精算：10899_seisan⟧ (exact calculation, settlement)
- ⟦{概略|がいりゃく}→概略：07768_gairyaku⟧ (outline, summary)

USAGE:
Commonly used in business contexts when discussing budgets, project costs, or preliminary planning stages.
